taskList.taskTitle: The governor's granddaughter is in trouble
taskList.taskDescription: The regional governor reported that his granddaughter got into some strange trouble. The only thing known is her location — go there and find out what happened yourself.
taskList.taskInfo: The governor's granddaughter got into trouble. She needs help.

taskList.taskDescription:
Grandmother Nyura has great authority in her village and can lead people. Thanks to her work, we won the last election, which is exactly why we must help her now so that she helps us again in the future.

There is almost no time left to delay, hurry to her and find out what needs to be done.
taskList.taskInfo: Authoritative Granny Nyura is in trouble. She needs help.

taskList.taskDescription:
Ahead of us all lie another gubernatorial elections. It is very important for us to reappoint our leader. Let us remain consolidated at this hour and ensure the governor a decent turnout at the elections.

And the percentages... They do not matter. There is no time to delay, head to the mass media office for materials as soon as possible.
taskList.taskInfo: Take part in campaigning and distribute 5 flyers.

taskList.taskDescription: The Government is looking for the best licenser for a generous reward. To become one, you need to sell any three licenses during the day, hurry up.
taskList.taskInfo: Sell 3 licenses to citizens.

taskList.taskTitle: Friends are not abandoned in trouble
taskList.taskDescription:
I am very glad that we were able to come to an agreement and convince you to earn a little more than you can in public service. In general, as everyone knows — in two weeks the Prosecutor General is coming for an inspection, and we would not like the accounting problem to become known.

You need to take the government archives, transport them out, and burn them. Do it quickly — you'll get your hard-earned money, but if you start dragging your feet — you'll get less. Your time has started, move.
taskList.taskInfo: Destroy the government papers before the inspection.

taskList.taskDescription:
How wonderful that you came back again. There is a special task, you need to pick up a bribe from the point indicated on this note.

If you handle it quickly and do not attract any unnecessary attention, you will get your percentage. But if you fail, you will go work in the mine. There is almost no time left, head out quickly.
taskList.taskInfo: The Minister of Finance instructed to collect a bribe.

taskList.taskDescription: Pass the test on knowledge of the organization's Charter. Select the "Documents" item, and after reading, click "To the test" for each item.

taskList.taskDescription: Guard towers need to be checked periodically. We don't want our sentries sleeping, do we? Forward!
taskList.taskInfo: Check 8 towers

taskList.taskDescription: The direct duty of the orderly is to keep the barracks clean. Proceed to your duties!
taskList.taskInfo: Put the barracks in order

taskList.taskDescription: Alarm! Intrusion onto the unit's territory! Quickly get a weapon and repel the attack at any cost!
taskList.taskInfo: Eliminate bandits on the unit territory

taskList.taskDescription: Gun stores won't restock themselves. So — get behind the wheel and move out!
taskList.taskInfo: Deliver the truck with materials to the faction

taskList.taskDescription: Our medicine supplies are almost at zero. This is not good! Deal with it quickly!
taskList.taskInfo: Create 3 medicines in the laboratory

taskList.taskDescription: Kitchen duty is every soldier's fate. By the next meal, the canteen must shine. Move!
taskList.taskInfo: Prepare the canteen for mealtime

taskList.taskDescription: What distinguishes a military unit from the neighboring village? A perimeter. Urgently go around and check it!
taskList.taskInfo: Walk around and check the perimeter of the military unit

taskList.taskDescription: A medical card is a medical document in which attending doctors record the patient's medical history and prescribed treatment. You need to issue five medical cards to residents of the region to complete the faction task.
taskList.taskInfo: Issue 5 medical cards to region residents.

taskList.taskDescription:
The hospital's main duty is to provide qualified and timely medical care to everyone who needs it.

You need to treat ten patients who are on the hospital grounds.
taskList.taskInfo: Heal 10 patients on the hospital grounds.

taskList.taskDescription:
The hospital's main duty is to provide qualified and timely medical care to everyone who needs it.

You need to take an ambulance, go out on calls, and save five injured people.
taskList.taskInfo: Resuscitate and save 5 injured people on calls.

taskList.taskDescription:
An acquaintance of mine reported that a draft medical commission was held quite recently, where he was declared fit for service, and all the personal files of the conscripts were transferred to our hospital.

You need to hack the cabinet door, seize the data from his medical book, and instead plant the documents I will give you.
taskList.taskInfo: Falsify the results of the draft commission.

taskList.taskDescription:
High-quality editing and checking of ads submitted by residents of the region is an important duty of every media employee.

You need to check and properly edit thirty ads sent by residents of our region.
taskList.taskInfo: Carefully check and edit 30 advertisements.

taskList.taskDescription:
Conducting high-quality and interesting broadcasts is an important duty of every mass media employee.

You need to conduct any interesting and engaging broadcast, during which you need to send 50 messages (/t).
taskList.taskInfo: Conduct an interesting 10-minute broadcast.

taskList.taskDescription:
Ahead of us all are the next governor elections. We need to notify all residents of the region about this event so that turnout is as high as possible.

You need to print campaign materials, take them, and distribute them to houses.
taskList.taskInfo: Distribute 5 campaign materials.

taskList.taskDescription:
An SD card is stored in our director's safe, containing very interesting information with facts of governor election fraud. Our director is against corruption and wants to take this material to the proper authorities.

 High-ranking government officials know about this and are very interested in obtaining it. They are ready to pay good money if you crack the director's safe, steal the SD card, and take it to the secretary, who is in the government building.
taskList.taskInfo: Steal the SD card and take it to the government.

taskList.taskDescription: Speeding is the main danger on the road. Fortunately, technology helps us fight reckless drivers
taskList.taskInfo: Place 2 stationary radars on the map

taskList.taskDescription: You can't put a camera on every road. Sometimes you have to take justice into your own hands
taskList.taskInfo: Issue 5 fines using a handheld radar

taskList.taskDescription: Forgetful drivers don't always need to be punished. Sometimes they can be helped too. Not for free, of course…
taskList.taskInfo: Provide a license renewal service 3 times

taskList.taskDescription: If someone somewhere around here doesn't want to live honestly, then we'll have to make them. Mount up!
taskList.taskInfo: Catch the criminal alone or with a partner

taskList.taskTitle: Lunch is the head of everything
taskList.taskDescription: The best part of patrol work is having a snack. Pull over to the diner!
taskList.taskInfo: Drive to any food place and have a snack

taskList.taskDescription: Patrolling is important. The mere presence of police can prevent a crime.
taskList.taskInfo: Drive along the patrol route

taskList.taskDescription: Nothing stirs the blood like a good chase after a criminal. Turn on the siren and let's go!
taskList.taskInfo: Successfully finish the chase

taskList.taskDescription: A traffic police post is a filter against suspicious individuals. Don't let them slip through!
taskList.taskInfo: Stop and inspect 2 vehicles at the traffic police post

taskList.taskDescription: What distinguishes our cars from ordinary ones? The presence of unpleasant surprises for violators. Try it yourself!
taskList.taskInfo: Use special means during chases

taskList.taskDescription: Most often our job is not chases and arrests, but ordinary patrol routine. Let's go
taskList.taskInfo: Drive 10 kilometers in a service vehicle

taskList.taskDescription: Working in a law enforcement agency is not easy. And if it's hard to cope alone, call your colleagues for help.
taskList.taskInfo: Create a call and use the help of colleagues.

taskList.taskDescription: Even criminals must be treated within the law, without allowing arbitrariness. Deliver the criminals to the station.
taskList.taskInfo: Arrest and deliver 2 players to the department.

taskList.taskDescription: Catching and delivering a lawbreaker to the station is often difficult, but that makes it even more important.
taskList.taskInfo: Catch 1 criminal alone or with a partner.

taskList.taskDescription: Evidence can be obtained in different ways, and the duty officer will never ask how it was obtained; for him, the main thing is to submit the report.
taskList.taskInfo: Hand over 5 pieces of evidence to the duty officer at the department.

taskList.taskDescription: Helping colleagues is an element of an efficiently working system. Help your colleagues with their difficult tasks.
taskList.taskInfo: Complete 1 call

taskList.taskDescription: Did you see a suspicious citizen or vehicle? Why didn't you search them? Fix it quickly!
taskList.taskInfo: Conduct a search of any inventories (vehicle, property, player inventory) on 5 different players

taskList.taskTitle: Lunch is the head of everything
taskList.taskDescription: The most pleasant thing about patrol work is the opportunity to stop by a food place and have a leisurely, tasty meal. So don't miss this opportunity!
taskList.taskInfo: Drive to any food place and buy something to eat

taskList.taskDescription: Patrolling is an important task. Even the mere presence of police officers can prevent a crime.
taskList.taskInfo: Drive 1 patrol route

taskList.taskDescription: Check several points on the patrol route and make sure no order violations have occurred.
taskList.taskInfo: Drive 10 kilometers along the route in a service vehicle while behind the wheel

taskList.taskInfo: Complete 1 task while undercover in another faction.

taskList.taskDescription: Management urgently needs a report on the work done by other factions! Immediately!
taskList.taskInfo: Go to one of the state factions (not only law enforcement) and take secret documents from the chief's office.

taskList.taskDescription: Patrolling is an important task. Even the mere presence of police officers can prevent a crime.
taskList.taskInfo: Drive 1 patrol route.

taskList.taskDescription: Were you taught to identify suspicious individuals in boot camp? Then what are we waiting for? Urgently search for such people and check their documents!
taskList.taskInfo: Check documents of 5 players

taskList.taskDescription: Catching and delivering a lawbreaker to the station is often difficult, but that makes it even more important.
taskList.taskInfo: Catch 1 criminal alone or with a partner

taskList.taskDescription: Honest businessmen? Our management doesn't believe in such fairy tales. Go on an inspection trip.
taskList.taskInfo: Conduct an on-site business inspection

taskList.taskDescription: Are there any wolves in sheep's clothing in the traffic police? Do they patrol the city honestly? You need to check this.
taskList.taskInfo: Get undercover in the Traffic Police and drive 5 kilometers in a service vehicle

taskList.taskDescription: Our faction has the best weapons and equipment. And so that it doesn't run out, get undercover in the Army and bring a truck of materials to our warehouse.
taskList.taskInfo: Get undercover in the Army and deliver 1 truck of materials to the FBI

taskList.taskDescription: We suspect that the Penitentiary Service leadership gives prisoners too many indulgences. Tighten their detention conditions.
taskList.taskInfo: Get undercover in the Penitentiary Service and issue reprimands to 2 prisoners

taskList.taskDescription: The investigation has additional questions for one of the convicts. Deliver his personal file to them.
taskList.taskInfo: Deliver the criminal's personal file to the City Police department

taskList.taskDescription: During transport to jail, the prisoner may be freed by accomplices. This must not be allowed!
taskList.taskInfo: Transport the inmate from the detention cell to prison.

taskList.taskDescription: Anything can happen on prison grounds, and it is not customary to ask about injuries. Just provide medical assistance to those who need it.
taskList.taskInfo: Heal 5 patients in the infirmary

taskList.taskDescription: Stashes can contain the most unexpected items. Find and search them before the prisoners use them.
taskList.taskInfo: Prevent an escape by searching 3 shared stashes

taskList.taskDescription: Stop! Search! Prisoners must not relax. They must always expect an unscheduled search.
taskList.taskInfo: Search 5 inmates on prison grounds

taskList.taskDescription: Everyone deserves individual treatment, and what kind is up to you. Show that treatment to several inmates.
taskList.taskInfo: Issue a reward to 5 prisoners.

taskList.taskDescription: The prison territory must be checked thoroughly! And quickly at that!.
taskList.taskInfo: Walk around and inspect the prison grounds.

taskList.taskDescription: There must be order everywhere - including in the cells. Go and check.
taskList.taskInfo: Visit all cells

taskList.taskDescription: Accomplices of inmates may prepare an ambush to free them. Check the route of the service vehicles and make sure everything is in order.
taskList.taskInfo: Check route security on the way to prison

taskList.taskDescription: Honest work - and honest rest! Head to the cafeteria and have a hearty lunch.
taskList.taskInfo: Consume any 3 dishes in the cafeteria on prison grounds
